title: After accusations of selling ‘perv glasses,’ Meta prepares to sell a pair without a camera
summary: The Information reports that Meta has developed a new smart glasses model, dubbed Luna, that, sans cameras, comes equipped with a convenient system to communicate with the company’s AI chatbot and Muse, its AI consumer agent.
